name: Lumina VocabBypass 2x2 ablation
time_scope: CUDA-synchronized wall time: prompt preparation + generation + VQ decode; excludes model loading, warmups, artifact saving, equality checks and scoring.
reset: Clear model KV/logit cache and reset Python/NumPy/TorchCPU/CUDA RNG to42 before each image. generate_image also resets cache at entry, unchanged.
equality: Check A/B and C/D separately: tokens, pixels and PNG bytes; no cache-off vs cache-on identity assumption.
stop: Any equality failure/runtime failure/disk<2GiB stops, preserving all evidence. No favorable-speed gate or outcome-based retry.
boundary: Eight predeclared DPG prompts, three repeats each, one fixed seed. Small performance/compatibility ablation, not a full quality benchmark; warmups excluded. Report B/A and D/C separately, all slower cases retained.
